title: Local linear lifting for a finitely presented source
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], Λ a commutative ring, M,N Λ-modules, P a presheaf of Λ-modules, and η:const(N)→P a linear natural transformation that is locally injective and locally surjective on underlying sets. Assume M is finitely presented. For every U and linear a:M→P(U), the sieve of arrows f:V→U for which there is a linear g:M→N with η_V∘g=P(f)∘a is covering.

source.place: Tag 093T, proof of (1), finite presentation and kernel argument, expanded as lifting finitely many generators and relations.

proof.text: Choose the finite generating set s and finitely generated kernel of p:Λ^(s)→M from Module.FinitePresentation.out. The span condition makes p surjective. Each a(s_i) has a covering image sieve under η. Intersect these finitely many covering sieves. On each arrow f in the intersection choose lifts n_i in N. Their linear extension q:Λ^(s)→N satisfies η_V q=P(f) a p, as checked on every basis vector and scalar.

Choose finitely many generators t of ker p. For each r in t, p(r)=0, so η_V(q(r))=η_V(0). Local injectivity of η makes the equality sieve of q(r) and zero covering. Intersect these finitely many sieves. On an arrow k in this intersection all q(r) vanish in N, since the source presheaf is constant. Hence ker p≤ker q. The quotient map from Λ^(s)/ker p to N, composed with the inverse of the first isomorphism theorem equivalence with M, gives g:M→N. For z in Λ^(s), g(p z)=q z. Surjectivity of p and naturality of η give η_W g=P(k≫f) a. Upward closure and transitivity of J prove that the entire lift sieve is covering. Empty generator or relation sets use the empty finite intersection, the maximal covering sieve, so the zero module is included.
